She has lost interest in swimming, which she previously found enjoyable. Additionally, she has had trouble getting a full night’s sleep and has had trouble concentrating during the day. She has lost 15 pounds since her last visit one year prior. Which of the following sets of neurotransmitter levels is associated with this patient’s condition?

opb. Increased acetylcholine, increased serotonin, decreased dopamine
opc. Increased norepinephrine, decreased serotonin, decreased GABA
opd. Decreased GABA, decreased acetylcholine, increased dopamine
ope. Decreased norepinephrine, decreased serotonin, decreased dopamine
